description: This file contains atomic operation implementations using GCC built-in functions, including fences, load/store, exchange, compare-and-swap, and fetch operations, tailored for different architectures.

methods.name: atomic_fence
methods.description: Issues a memory fence based on the specified memory order, with architecture-specific instructions.

methods.name: atomic_pre_sc_load_fence
methods.description: Issues a pre-sequence fence for sequential consistency load operations, architecture-dependent.

methods.name: atomic_post_sc_store_fence
methods.description: Issues a post-sequence fence for sequential consistency store operations, architecture-dependent.
